issue.title: KeyError while looking up FanoutHost causes multiple test failures

failure.body:
**Description**

Multiple tests failed due to KeyError while looking up fanouthost.

**Steps to reproduce the issue:**
1. Run single_lag test in pc/test_lag_2.py

**Describe the results you received:**
All single_lag cases fail with "KeyError: u'str2-z9332f-03'" error

    def run_single_lag_test(self, lag_name, lag_facts):
        logger.info("Start checking single lag for: %s" % lag_name)

        intf, _ = self.__get_lag_intf_info(lag_facts, lag_name)

        # Figure out fanout switches info if exists for the lag member and run minlink test
        if intf in self.fanout_neighbors.keys():
            peer_device   = self.fanout_neighbors[intf]['peerdevice']
            neighbor_intf = self.fanout_neighbors[intf]['peerport']
           self.__verify_lag_minlink(self.fanouthosts[peer_device], lag_name, lag_facts, neighbor_intf, deselect_time=5)
           **KeyError: u'str2-z9332f-03'**

**Describe the results you expected:**
No errors seen and single_lag tests should pass

**Additional information you deem important:**

   SONiC Software Version: SONiC.20201231.16
   Distribution: Debian 10.10
   Kernel: 4.19.0-12-2-amd64
   Build commit: decfa37df2
   Build date: Wed Aug 11 <IPV6> UTC 2021
   Built by: AzDevOps@sonic-int-build-workers-0002L6

resolution.title: Fix duplicate module name
resolution.description:

Summary:
Fixes https://github.com/Azure/sonic-mgmt/issues/4043

Multiple test case failure with "KeyError" in latest image

#### How did you do it?
Fixed using a different alias name

#### How did you verify/test it?
Manual run of pc/test_lag_2.py.  Reproduced the error before the fix and verified that the changes address the issue and the test case passes.
